items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: Leon Thomas always got together... Pharoah said man, you know why don’t we all just get together? And it worked.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I’m assuming that you sort of wrote out the melody with a little more precision?

Right. And so you know that was it. And we did it. But back then, you know, everything was just more creative. Because we did that whole record in one night and I mean we was just very creative, every time Pharoah and Leon. Leon Thomas always got together. You could start with something and then you just keep exploring and just keep going.
You know it takes an open-minded producer I think to just, or at least someone who just stays out of the way.
